Name: Truant
Effect: Roll this Pokémon's Loyalty every other turn, and score at least 2 successes. If it is Successful it may act normally. If the Roll Fails this Pokémon refuses to act; then roll 1 Chance Dice, if Successful the Pokémon uses a Free Action to perform the Move Rest.
Description: This Pokémon is extremely lazy. They won't make even the tiniest effort to do anything even in the heat of battle.
